    function init() {

        if (!navs.length) return;
        navs.forEach(function (nav) {
            var active = nav.querySelector('a.is-active');
            // 1) Center the active pill in the scroll container.
            if (active && nav.scrollWidth > nav.clientWidth) {
                var navRect    = nav.getBoundingClientRect();
                var activeRect = active.getBoundingClientRect();
                var offset     = (activeRect.left - navRect.left)

                nav.scrollTo({left: Math.max(0, offset), behavior: 'auto'});

            window.addEventListener('resize', syncEdges, {passive: true});
